docs.description: It's a very exploratory book that sheds light on the scandals of the corporate world. A nation where rich industrial captains run the government or pull the strings from behind the screen. Dhirubhai Ambani unscrupulously bought every Congress politician and got his licenses renewed. The book is  a  tell-all-and-expose-it style of work, that tells us that Indian democracy is truly nonsense.
